Ada Lovelace

Ada Lovelace was an English mathematician and writer.

Early life

She developed an interest in mathematics while receiving a broad private education.

Her studies included geometry, algebra, music, and several modern languages.

Work on the Analytical Engine

Lovelace published extensive notes about Charles Babbage's proposed mechanical computer.

One note described a method for calculating Bernoulli numbers with the machine.

The machine might act upon things other than number.

Legacy

  • Her notes are studied in the history of computing.
  • The Ada programming language was named in her honour.
